name: Phone Connect (phone) help
description: Help for the Phone Connect Android app (help@1): the one-time setup page and the overlay.
author: Brett

entries.title: Set up once
entries.text: Sign in to axHub, pair with the code the console shows, allow notifications and display over other apps. After that there are no app screens.

entries.title: Sign in to axHub
entries.text: Your own hub account. Pairing and approving use this session only, never a token.

entries.title: Pair
entries.text: Type the 8-character code from Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect, or scan its QR with the camera.

entries.title: Display over other apps
entries.text: Lets the floating toolbar and popups show on top of every app.

entries.title: Floating toolbar
entries.text: Your buttons and widgets from the console's Overlay settings. It folds into the button after a while.

entries.title: Floating button
entries.text: Tap to open the toolbar, drag to move it. The badge counts waiting approvals.

entries.title: Approval popup
entries.text: A held call with its reason. Approve, Deny or Shelve right here, with your own hub session. The lock screen only says Approval waiting.

entries.title: Alert popup
entries.text: Something broke or needs a look. Open takes you to the page; Dismiss closes it.

entries.title: Recorder
entries.text: Records what the phone plays in 30-minute parts and sends them to axHub. Android asks every start; your mic only when its switch is on.

entries.title: Monitor
entries.text: Keeps watching for approvals and alerts with the screen off. Its quiet notification shows while it runs.
